docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
An American painter's account of the months she spent at the Qing court painting the portrait of the Empress Dowager Cixi.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Katharine A. Carl (1865–1938), With the Empress Dowager of China, 1905. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
